name: io.github.fuih/stu-packet-tracer-mcp
description: Student-focused MCP server for Cisco Packet Tracer 9 — live IOS CLI, terminal screenshots (SVG/PNG), student lab checks, and DOCX/HTML/Markdown report export.

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Localhost port for the internal HTTP bridge that talks to the Packet Tracer 9 extension (default: 54321)

environmentVariables.name: STU_PT_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where CLI screenshots and exported lab reports are saved (default: ./stu-pt-output)

environmentVariables.name: STU_PT_TEACH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to force dry-run/explain-only study mode without modifying Packet Tracer (default: off)

environmentVariables.name: STU_PT_BRIDGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional shared secret required in the X-Stu-Token header by the local Packet Tracer bridge
